outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News in the United States, the network's national and world file is leading with Trump, House Speaker Johnson expected to meet with tech CEOs on AI next week: Sources; LIVE: ABC News Live; 'Like a horror movie': Ukraine's Oleshky faces 'catastrophe' under Russian occupation.

items.headline: Trump, House Speaker Johnson expected to meet with tech CEOs on AI next week: Sources
items.detail: The meeting comes as the leaders of some AI companies have issued warnings.

items.headline: LIVE: ABC News Live
items.detail: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

items.headline: 'Like a horror movie': Ukraine's Oleshky faces 'catastrophe' under Russian occupation
items.detail: Messages sent by residents in Oleshky and seen by ABC News tell of careful rationing of remaining food supplies, a chronic shortage of medication and constant attacks.

items.headline: Dolly Parton's final vocal recording to appear on U2's new album 'Carnaval de Luz'
items.detail: Dolly Parton's last recording of her career will appear on U2's new album.

items.headline: WATCH: 13-year-old pursuing master's degree at NYU
items.detail: Joe Petraro-Hyppolite has an IQ of 168 and is one of the youngest people ever accepted into an NYU master's program.
